h: Gunmen reportedly open fire on an NDC candidate's convoy in Ebonyi, killing one person
p: Gunmen reportedly attacked the convoy of a candidate of the NDC in Ebonyi State, killing one person and injuring three others. Police are yet to give full details of the incident.
more: Security concerns around the 2027 campaigns are in focus.
Parties have urged the police to investigate.
